⚠️ ВНИМАНИЕ! ПРОЧТИ МЕНЯ! / READ ME! ⚠️
Neron H3 Engine v2.0 — Hard
Описание и настройки — кнопка 📖 Help / Справка на ноде.
Description and settings — 📖 Help button on the node.

==================================================
📦 НОДЫ / CUSTOM NODES
==================================================
• Neron H3 Engine — [ССЫЛКА / LINK]
• VideoHelperSuite — https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite
• Comfyroll — https://github.com/Suzie1/ComfyUI_Comfyroll_CustomNodes

==================================================
🧠 ОСНОВНАЯ МОДЕЛЬ / MAIN MODEL → models/diffusion_models
==================================================
Выбери одну (или несколько) / Pick one (or more):

• Максимум / Maximum — bf16, 40 ГБ (без сжатия, лучшее качество):
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_bf16.safetensors

• Стандарт / Standard — int8, 21 ГБ:
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors

• Лёгкие / Light — fp8 21 ГБ, w6a8 16 ГБ:
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_fp8_scaled.safetensors
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_w6a8.safetensors

Если bf16 скачана — нода выберет её сама.
If bf16 is downloaded, the node picks it automatically.

==================================================
📝 ТЕКСТОВЫЙ ЭНКОДЕР / TEXT ENCODER → models/text_encoders
==================================================
• nvfp4, 15.7 ГБ (по умолчанию / default):
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors

• int8, 27 ГБ (если nvfp4 не идёт на твоей видеокарте / if nvfp4 doesn't run on your GPU):
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors

==================================================
🎞 VAE → models/vae
==================================================
• Видео / Video, 5.2 ГБ:
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors

• Звук / Audio, 0.6 ГБ:
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors

==================================================
⚡ ТУРБО-LoRA / TURBO LoRA → models/loras
==================================================
• 2 ГБ (обязательна для режима Турбо / required for Turbo mode):
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors

==================================================
💾 СОХРАНЕНИЕ / SAVING
==================================================
Video Combine → format: video/h264-mp4 (не gif! / not gif!)
